item.title: Comparative Cognition Society (CO3)
item.why_it_fits: THE defining society for this profile. Student awards (publication, best talk/poster, travel) plus the Stan Kuczaj Memorial Travel Grant; a separate Early Career Award exists for later (first 5 yrs post-PhD, $1000).
item.eligibility_notes: Must be a current CCS member to apply for any of the awards.
item.deadline: student-award deadlines ~Dec; Stan Kuczaj travel grant ~28 Feb

research.note: Grant item — research is the call page summary; see eligibility notes.
